study.question: Can compact within-bin moment directions improve timing_joint beyond a capacity-matched duplicated-histogram head when they enrich, rather than replace, its histogram anchor, with each readout input norm matched to the duplicated control?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: lean mixed compact improves on its duplicate (AUC 0.6312652412 vs 0.6309988567), but relative balancing reverses their ordering (0.6312215833 vs 0.6313014542). Mixed versus additive improves both evidence families, so nonlinear capacity is an alternative to compact complementarity. The balanced duplicate beats timing_joint (0.6306853561) but has worse logloss (0.1926933124 vs 0.1926808861), whereas unbalanced lean compact has logloss 0.1926277570. Candidate-supplied diagnostics on only the first 512 validation rows report compact gain mean 3.667, max 4, and tail RMS 0.01957 to 0.05917, without a performance benefit; this does not establish a normalization mechanism. Mechanism hypothesis: replacing three histogram pathways with moments sacrifices useful count representation, while amplifying the small moment views can worsen optimization. Preserve the balanced duplicate count anchor and add only each raw moment vector component orthogonal to the histogram, then rescale the sum to the original anchor norm. This changes directions, adds no parameters or global magnitude, and does not amplify moments. Predict incremental validation AUC over the stronger duplicate and timing source; one seed remains provisional.

nearest_work.difference: Exact frozen parent, source checksum verified. Keep every learned parameter, allocation order, optimizer and balanced histogram anchor. Only deterministic input directions to the existing four-projection head change.
Parent replaces three count views by relatively amplified moment views. Proposed model instead enriches the count views with unamplified orthogonal raw moments and matches per-view input norms.

DIN uses target-conditioned event activation with unnormalized intensity. Target-match groups and pooling are inherited here; proposed transformation acts on fixed empirical summary directions and preserves the count norm. The provided baseline uses normalized attention and is only DIN-style.

UniDot bypasses fusion with learned dot products, and its tiny-mode fusion removal raises AUC while worsening logloss. No dot-product highway, buses, auxiliary delay head or optimizer is introduced here; a pre-existing shallow summary head receives deterministic count-orthogonal enrichment. No local transfer or priority claim.

Only README inspected; full paper remains unavailable through archive. It confirms category/brand/action histories without items. No item matching or auxiliary targets are assumed. Detailed novelty relative to DMR is unverified.

inherited_components: Frozen timing_joint representation, chronological product transition branch, lifted gap head and joint timing table; trained from scratch, never checkpoint warm-started.

Four 64-to-8 bias-free projections, fixed orthogonal Hadamard mixing before ReLU, existing 68-to-32 context gate, zero-initialized 32-to-1 output; 4256 extra parameters over timing_joint, expected total 17257651 and dense 178963.
Four target-match groups by four behavior types by four age bins; count log1p scaling and raw conditional mean/variance/absolute third-moment formulas.
Per-impression bounded relative balancing for duplicated histogram only, with all histogram/intensity inputs and the full timing parent retained.
Frozen supplied 128-event causal prefix, data identity, 3 epochs, batch4096, Adam lr0.001, BCE and seed42; no new information, loss, optimizer, sampling or tuning.
study.proposed_difference: Let H be the 64-vector count histogram and A_i its corresponding balanced duplicate anchor. Keep input0=H. For each raw compact moment M_i (conditional mean contrast, observed variance, third-moment magnitude), compute R_i=M_i-H*<H,M_i>/max(<H,H>,1e-12). Set V_i=A_i+R_i and X_i=V_i*sqrt(<A_i,A_i>/max(<V_i,V_i>,1e-12)). Empty inputs stay zero. Existing projections/context/mixing/readout then consume (H,X_1,X_2,X_3). Orthogonal residuals remove the histogram-parallel direction and each final norm matches the duplicated control. Norm preservation does not preserve every histogram coordinate: the anchor is retained in direction with reduced coefficient after rescaling. No model parameters or RNG draws added. Include an unsubmitted enrichment_mode=duplicate exact-control path for reproduction and host diagnostics. This is a local mechanism contrast, not a verified novel method.
predictions: Primary: full-population validation AUC exceeds g0-r0027-balance_duplicate 0.63130145421691 and g1-r0022-timing_joint 0.6306853561453415. Improvement only over timing_joint does not support compact incremental utility.

Secondary: compare logloss against duplicate 0.19269331242038432, timing_joint 0.1926808860955089 and unbalanced lean compact 0.19262775696613768; an AUC-only gain does not establish a calibration benefit.

Host diagnostics should reproduce frozen timing logits, exact zero-innovation duplicate readout, finite logits and raw moment oracles; input norm, orthogonality, masking, empty-history, zero-length, reorder and row-independence checks should pass within float32 tolerance (1e-5 for feature algebra; 1e-4 logits).

Count-proportional synthetic moments must yield a null enrichment; a same-coarse-bin age witness must leave timing and histogram fixed while changing compact inputs. Witness sensitivity establishes wiring, not predictive usefulness.

Expected identical parameter counts; wall time near recent lean/balance 857-899 seconds and inference near 28 seconds. Any efficiency claim requires measured costs and latency, not equal parameter counts. No unseen/missing-field slice is invented; host-defined slices are exploratory with their receipt sample and class counts.
falsifiers: Failing to beat the strongest duplicated control leaves incremental directional compact-evidence utility unsupported for this implementation; beating timing_joint alone can be explained by redundant capacity.

A larger input norm, added parameters, changed source initialization or failed duplicate-null/orthogonality/source checks invalidates the intended attribution and requires retaining a failed receipt, not silently altering protocol.
Equal norm and parameter count do not rule out a beneficial regularization/optimization bias. Even a positive one-seed contrast is not mechanism confirmation or statistical significance.
If norm matching removes useful parallel moment magnitude, failure does not refute all compact evidence; this test only addresses directional enrichment without amplification.
A worse quality-cost frontier or logloss prevents an unqualified efficiency or calibration claim.
alternative_explanations: Seed42 variation, validation selection across trajectories, and checkpoint selection can explain small deltas; no authorized paired predictions or user bootstrap interface is supplied.
Existing duplicate improvement reflects extra nonlinear capacity/context gating. Norm-preserving enrichment changes input conditioning, angular distribution and within-head optimization together.
Only first512 validation rows support feature-scale diagnostics; do not extrapolate their occupied-cell distribution to the full population.
Timing and compact evidence share history ancestry; orthogonality in a 64-vector is not conditional independence or removal of all predictive redundancy.
Observed variance and absolute third moments include sampling noise and low-support estimates; a null may arise from noise or discarded parallel magnitude, not absent temporal information.
Historical matched controls lack contemporaneous hardware pairing. Equal recipe/data passes isolate code changes more closely than equal measured compute; measured cost frontier remains descriptive.
Static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented, identities are bucketed, and history is truncated. All conclusions concern this frozen benchmark, not verified production point-in-time data.
